session.description: Reference bf16 activation rounding as the official BreezeTTS 2 inference does it. auto = on for CUDA/HIP/Vulkan and off on Metal, where the cast cost is visible even with the fused round-to-bf16 op (~20% slower AR loop); on/off force it either way. session.name: perf_mode
session.description: AR decode preset. off uses the normal defaults (fused_depth, direct_prefill and skip_cache_round enabled on CUDA, Vulkan and Metal); cuda_perf additionally enables batched_cfg on CUDA. Explicit session options override the preset.

session.name: fused_depth
session.description: Decode each frame's depth codebooks in one backend graph with device-side CFG mixing and sampling. Device sampling uses the per-codebook path's torch random draws, so CUDA output normally matches it token for token. Vulkan/Metal sampling uses a different draw mapping. CUDA, Vulkan and Metal only.

session.name: direct_prefill
session.description: Offline generation prefills the backbone straight into the decode cache, as streaming does, instead of exporting the KV state to the host and importing it back. Same computation. CUDA, Vulkan and Metal only.

session.name: skip_cache_round
session.description: Skip re-rounding the F16 KV cache to bf16 after each update, which is an identity because the K/V rows are already bf16-rounded. Applies only with the bf16 reference path and flash attention. CUDA, Vulkan and Metal only.

session.name: round_bf16_fusion
session.description: Fold the bf16 activation rounding into the CUDA RMS-norm, add and SwiGLU kernels that produce it. Bit-identical to the unfused graph, with fewer kernel launches. CUDA only.

session.name: batched_cfg
session.description: With guidance_scale != 1, decode the conditional and unconditional backbone branches as one batch-2 step. Batching changes matmul accumulation order, so output differs from the two-runtime path. CUDA only.

request.description: Trim the speaker reference to at most this many seconds before encoding. Shorter references are cheaper and often clone better; upstream's guidance favours around 10 s. request.description: Cap the generation window, in seconds (up to 29.7215 s, the trained maximum; larger values are clamped to it). Quantised down to a whole latent frame of 46.44 ms. Left unset, the window is estimated per chunk from text length and widened automatically if the utterance does not finish inside it, which is substantially cheaper for short text. Must be positive; rounded to at least one latent frame.

request.name: guidance_interval
request.description: Refresh the two unconditional CFG lanes only every Nth step inside the guidance window, reusing the previous guidance correction in between. 1 reproduces upstream exactly. Worth raising to 2 at 30+ steps, where the correction is still measured 8-10 times across the guided phase (roughly 1.3x fewer denoiser evaluations); not recommended below ~20 steps, where it is already coarsely sampled and staleness shows up as degraded timbre and text adherence.

session.name: cpu_repack
session.description: On the CPU, multiply the matrices with the kernels of ggml's CPU extra buffer types where those take the weight's type and shape: the repacked ones take Q4_0 on x86 with AVX2 and Q4_0, Q8_0 and Q6_K on Arm; where ggml's AMX buffer is built, it comes first and also takes F16, Q8_0 and K-quants.
